_doc: Fine-grained research themes for the Atlas. Each wiki summary page gets 1-3 theme ids (connectors/themes/tag.py). Areas are the wiki's topic folders. Edit freely; re-run tag.py --retag to re-classify.

themes.label: LLM routing & cascades
themes.desc: Choosing which model answers a query: routers, cascades, model selection, cost-quality trade-off, query difficulty estimation.

themes.label: Agent & trajectory routing
themes.desc: Routing inside agent runs: per-step model delegation, sub-agent dispatch, cheap-vs-frontier model per decision, tool/agent selection.

themes.label: MoE expert routing
themes.desc: Mixture-of-experts gating, expert load balancing, expert pruning/merging, expert parallelism.

themes.label: Speculative decoding
themes.desc: Draft-and-verify decoding, drafters, multi-token prediction, parallel decoding.

themes.label: KV cache eviction & selection
themes.desc: Choosing which KV entries/tokens to keep, drop or recompute; sparse attention over the cache; long-context cache budgets.

themes.label: KV cache compression
themes.desc: Quantizing, low-rank projecting or merging the KV cache; MLA-style latent caches; predicting values from keys.

themes.label: Prefix caching & KV reuse
themes.desc: Prompt/prefix caching, cross-request KV sharing, KV offloading to CPU/SSD, cache-aware scheduling, KV transfer between agents.

themes.label: Context & prompt compression
themes.desc: Shrinking what goes into the context: prompt compression, compaction, memory tokens, context-rot mitigation, token budgets.

themes.label: Weight & activation quantization
themes.desc: Low-bit weights/activations (FP8, FP4, INT4, ternary), quantization-aware training, GGUF quants, outlier handling.

themes.label: Distillation
themes.desc: Teacher-student training, on-policy distillation, logit/hidden-state matching, self-distillation.

themes.label: Pruning & sparsity
themes.desc: Structured/unstructured pruning, layer dropping, activation sparsity, early exit, depth reduction.

themes.label: Test-time compute allocation
themes.desc: Budgeting reasoning tokens, adaptive thinking length, best-of-n allocation, overthinking, efficient reasoning.

themes.label: Serving systems & batching
themes.desc: Inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), scheduling, batching, disaggregated prefill/decode, throughput/latency SLOs.

themes.label: Training efficiency
themes.desc: Cheaper training: parallelism, communication, RL rollout efficiency, weight refit, MFU, data efficiency.

themes.label: GPU kernels & compilers
themes.desc: Attention kernels (FlashAttention), fused kernels, Triton/CUDA/TLX, megakernels, agent-written kernels, compilers.

themes.label: GPU & accelerator architecture
themes.desc: Hopper/Blackwell/Rubin, TPUs, custom AI chips, memory hierarchy, interconnects, on-device inference hardware.

themes.label: HBM & memory supply chain
themes.desc: HBM, DRAM, NAND, memory pricing and shortages, advanced packaging (CoWoS).

themes.label: Fabs & semiconductor industry
themes.desc: Foundries, process nodes, chip manufacturing, export controls, semiconductor economics.

themes.label: Datacenters & compute economics
themes.desc: Datacenter buildouts, power, GPU rental prices, capex, neoclouds, cost per token.

themes.label: Harness engineering
themes.desc: Designing the code, prompts, tools and loop around a model: agent scaffolds, coding-agent harnesses, skills, AGENTS.md.

themes.label: Self-improving harnesses
themes.desc: Harnesses that rewrite themselves: harness evolution, recursive self-improvement without weight updates, meta-harness search.

themes.label: Agent cost & token efficiency
themes.desc: What agent runs cost and how to cut it: wasted reasoning, context re-reads, cheaper tool calls, cost-aware agents.

themes.label: Agent memory
themes.desc: Long-term/episodic memory for agents, memory stores, retrieval for agents, skill libraries.

themes.label: Multi-agent systems
themes.desc: Agent teams, swarms, orchestration, communication between agents (text or latent).

themes.label: Tool use & computer use
themes.desc: Function calling, MCP, GUI/browser/computer-use agents, tool observation handling.

themes.label: Agent benchmarks & environments
themes.desc: Benchmarks and training environments for agents, long-horizon evals, SWE/terminal benchmarks.

themes.label: Verification & formal methods
themes.desc: Agents plus trusted checkers: Lean proofs, formal verification, verified code optimization, provable inference.

themes.label: RL & post-training
themes.desc: RLHF/RLVR/GRPO, reward models, post-training recipes, reasoning training.

themes.label: New architectures
themes.desc: SSMs, hybrids, linear/new attention, looped/recurrent transformers, diffusion LMs, long-context architecture.

themes.label: Frontier model releases
themes.desc: New frontier or open-weight model launches, model/system cards, benchmark results of named models.

themes.label: Scaling laws & pretraining
themes.desc: Scaling laws, pretraining data and recipes, tokenization, emergent behaviour studies.

themes.label: Interpretability
themes.desc: Mechanistic interpretability, probes, SAEs, circuits, steering.

themes.label: Alignment & safety
themes.desc: Alignment, reward hacking, misbehaviour, jailbreaks, backdoors, control, agent security.

themes.label: Governance & policy
themes.desc: Regulation, policy, AI governance, societal impact.

themes.label: Vision, audio & video
themes.desc: Vision-language models, image/video generation, speech, audio, world models.

themes.label: Robotics & 3D
themes.desc: Robotics, VLA policies, 3D reconstruction, spatial mapping.

themes.label: Industry & business
themes.desc: Company strategy, products, funding, M&A, market moves, adoption.
